comparison.objective: Place a drain pan before removing an engine drain plug, then retain the plug in a parts dish.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequence pan placement and plug extraction while avoiding a represented spill.
comparison.success_condition: Pan remains under the outlet whenever the plug is out; full credit also requires the plug in the dish.
comparison.reason: Although both enforce safe sequencing, this record tests containment-before-extraction, not fine tool engagement, setting retention, or iterative dynamic tuning.
